title: The private-path wording of five docs and the kb-setup skill names only kb/_querylog/ where kbpublic.PRIVATE_LABEL also names _logs.csv, _private and _cache, and the wording test cannot see them
goal: kb/_self/git.md (the Public home lines that name what publish leaves out), kb/_self/maintaining.md and .claude/skills/kb-setup/SKILL.md name the private paths as kbpublic.PRIVATE_LABEL does (_logs.csv, _private and _cache in any directory, with kb/_querylog/), and the wording test in test_sync.py (GIT_MD_PRIVATE_ROWS / private_docs) covers those lines so a planted old wording fails; found by the SP-nq5avzrl review

run: import re,sys;bad=[(f,n) for f in ("kb/_self/git.md","kb/_self/maintaining.md",".claude/skills/kb-setup/SKILL.md") for n,l in enumerate(open(f,encoding="utf-8"),1) if "kb/_querylog/" in l and re.search("public home|publish",l) and "_logs.csv" not in l];print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

repro_reason: the defect is the wording of docs read by a person setting up the public remote; the repro reads the lines for the full private-path list
